Compact Groundcar. Upgrades: Armored Chassis, TUp (Enhanced) Autopilot Terminal, Bulletproof Glass [x2], Combat Plow, TUp (Self-Driving Vehicle) Communications Center, Heavy Chassis, Reinforced Tires, Sealed Environment, Onboard Rocket Pod. Drives itself at Skill Base 14; no Maneuvers except an Emergency Stop, unless the fare buys more. Basic 50eb a district (100eb minimum): avoids nothing. Super 100eb a district (500eb minimum): dodges police and traffic when it can, never fights. Excelsior 500eb a district (1,000eb minimum): uses every weapon and system it has to protect you, police and corp security included.

Cost: 64,500eb
Nomad: 8 (Delamain)
SDP: 50
SP: 13
Seats: 4
MOVE: 20
Speed: 100 mph
